title: Font size problem xdrip+
body:
Hello and merry xmas. I just got my new phone, and a g5.. Dexcom app dosent work so i go whit xdrip, works great!
Now to the problem, font size on the text on the graph all of a sudden got really big.. It dosent matter if i change the screen size in options to smaller, it's still bigger then before. Saw an old thread about that here earlier.. Any fix to this? Make the text on the graph smaller? I have android 7.1, razer phone. 
![screenshot_20171223-233655](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34807314/34325258-2edd878a-e88d-11e7-981d-4865a90b6e80.png)
